title: Playing with Punch, then Ridgley's Tuxedo and the split with Celestin
summary: After Jesse Jackson Happy played with Kid Punch, then Ridgley's Tuxedo; the falling-out between Ridgley and Celestin led to two Tuxedo bands.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
